claim: Source-mapped native projection of loaded-window open/front/order state, initial recalculation, movable-window clamp/save-origin, and close restore. This is not a complete DOS rendering equivalence claim.

facts: when g_5702[0] equals requested window, skips lock/recalculate/open/draw and still calls win_FlushEvents
otherwise stores four caller words at window+0x10 then calls win_Recalc
only flag 0x1000 invokes f_2505_0288 and screen/menu clamping
saves object-zero origin, adjusts left/top, and recalculates only when movable-window branch is taken
sets front, open bit 0x0200, draw hooks, then flushes events
clears open bit and restores saved origin only for flag 0x1000
does not recalculate after restoring origin
recalculation writes object geometry and the window frame from object zero

actual_asset_probe.provenance: Actual HCEGANT/profile-0 registry resources; the test opens each through portable_window_open_apply, which invokes actual registry recalculation. These resources do not exercise the 0x1000 branch.

cases: open actual profile-0 windows 0,1,18,19 in order
reopen current front window; only event flush
raise already-open window; preserve open count and move to front
close current front and restore prior front
reject unloaded window without implicit resource load
synthetic runtime movable flag: exact bottom clamp and close origin restoration

limits: four DOS vararg words and menu/screen geometry must be supplied by caller; no defaults are invented
synthetic movable-flag case is not an actual HCEGANT record
object flags, handlers, draw hooks, and physical rendering are represented as explicit events/flags; this model does not execute their complete DOS side effects
full original win_Open DOS run was not certified because its display path reached the original raster primitive and subsequent callback boundary was unresolved
